_comment: Example output of: node harness.mjs --variant T1-P --users 5 --edits 50 --out results/T1-P.json. Machine values are placeholders; a real run records the actual host (US-31).

limits_in_force.people_limit: not enforced yet (US-63); NFR2 design target is 10 users
limits_in_force.module_size_limit: document frame cap 1 MiB (DocumentHandler), per-module content limit is US-63

room_full_check.note: no people limit enforced yet (US-63); extra join was accepted

write_permission_check: active (NFR13/CR13): every document-change frame is permission-checked by the relay. A without-check baseline needs a server-side toggle (not in main); see README.
note: Development-machine run. The final-host run (US-31) re-runs this with --url pointing at the deployed sync-service.
